intro: Understand the work, submit evidence, and follow your review.
noResources: No supporting resources have been added.
historyHint: Each submission and its supervisor feedback are kept here.
noEvidence: Your submitted evidence will appear here.
awaiting: Your evidence is awaiting supervisor review.
readOnly: This is a teammate’s task. You can view the details, but only its assigned trainee can start or submit it.
overdue: The deadline has passed. Starting and uploading are closed. Contact your supervisor.
startHint: Start when you are ready to work. Your start time will be recorded.
revisionHint: Review the feedback below, then upload your corrected PDF. Earlier submissions will be preserved.
submitHint: Finished the work? Upload PDF evidence to send the task for review. Your supervisor will confirm completion.
invalidFile: Choose a PDF file no larger than 10 MB.
done: Your supervisor approved this task. Well done.
unavailable: No action is available for this task.
failed: Unable to load or update the task. Please try again.
downloadFailed: Unable to download evidence. Please try again.
programHint: Open a phase, then select a task to view its details and next step.
